button: Caption of a clickable button. Imperative mood, no trailing period, short enough not to widen the button. Never a description of what happened.
buttonProgress: Temporarily replaces a button caption while the action is in flight. Present progressive, ends with an ellipsis, and must fit the same button as the resting caption.
progress: A standalone in-flight caption, shown beside a spinner or in a placeholder row while data loads. Present progressive, ends with an ellipsis. Not attached to a button, and not an error or an empty state.
menuItem: A row in a dropdown menu, combobox, or option list. Same register as a button, but usually a noun phrase when it names a choice rather than an action.
navItem: A destination in the sidebar or a tab strip. Short noun phrase, no period, stable wording because users navigate by muscle memory.
pageTitle: The heading identifying a whole screen. Noun phrase, title-like, no period. Also read out as the document title in some places.
sectionTitle: The heading of a card, panel, or group of fields within a screen. Noun phrase, no period.
dialogTitle: The heading of a modal dialog. States the decision being asked for, no period.
dialogBody: Explanatory or confirmation text inside a modal. Full sentences with periods. Say plainly what will happen, especially when it is destructive or irreversible.
fieldLabel: The label attached to an input control. Noun phrase, no period, no trailing colon (the framework supplies the layout).
fieldHint: Secondary guidance shown under or beside a field. Full sentence or short phrase, explains the accepted format or the consequence of the setting.
placeholder: Ghost text inside an empty input. An example of a valid value or a short prompt, never a restatement of the label.
ariaLabel: Accessible name announced by a screen reader for a control with no visible text. Describe the action, not the icon. Never localized as an abbreviation.
tooltip: Text revealed on hover or focus. Adds information the visible label omits; short and without a period unless it is a full sentence.
columnHeader: The header of a table column. Very short noun phrase, no period, because the column width is driven by the data.
statusBadge: A compact state label inside a coloured badge or pill. One or two words. Keep it short; badges do not wrap.
toast: A transient confirmation or notification message bar. Reports the outcome of a completed action in full sentences, past tense.
validationError: Feedback about invalid input, shown next to the field or in the form. Says what is wrong and what to do instead; second person, full sentence.
apiDiagnostic: The English fallback for a machine-readable diagnostic code returned by the backend. Translate the sentence, never the code. These are shown to administrators, so they may name technical concepts precisely.
emptyState: Text shown where a list, table, or chart has nothing to show. Explains the absence and, where useful, the next step. Not an error.
chartLabel: An axis title, series name, legend entry, or tooltip label on a chart. Extremely tight on space; abbreviate rather than wrap.
fragment: A partial string concatenated with another rendered value, such as a date or a number. Read its `joins` note before translating: word order and any leading or trailing space are load-bearing.
prose: Running descriptive or explanatory copy, such as a paragraph on a settings page or documentation shown in the console. Full sentences; the only surface where length is not tightly constrained.
